expo_router_file_based.name: Expo Router File-Based Navigation
expo_router_file_based.description: Use file-system routing: app/(tabs)/, app/[id].tsx, etc.
expo_router_file_based.convention: Each screen is a file. Layout groups with _layout.tsx. Dynamic params with [param].tsx.

zustand_mmkv_persistence.name: Zustand + MMKV Persistence
zustand_mmkv_persistence.description: State management with Zustand, persisted through MMKV for native performance
zustand_mmkv_persistence.convention: Create stores with persist middleware, MMKV storage adapter

react_query_data_fetching.name: React Query for Server State
react_query_data_fetching.description: All API calls go through React Query. No manual useEffect + fetch.
react_query_data_fetching.convention: useQuery for reads, useMutation for writes. Query keys follow [domain, entity, id].
react_query_data_fetching.cacheTime: 5 minutes default, 30 minutes for reference data

zod_validation_everywhere.name: Zod Validation
zod_validation_everywhere.description: Validate at every boundary: forms, API responses, route params, storage reads
zod_validation_everywhere.convention: Define schemas in shared/validation/. Infer types with z.infer<>. Use in React Hook Form.

nativewind_styling.name: NativeWind Styling
nativewind_styling.description: All styling through Tailwind utility classes via NativeWind
nativewind_styling.convention: Use design system token classes. No inline StyleSheet.create. Theme via tailwind.config.

flashlist_large_lists.name: FlashList for Scrollable Data
flashlist_large_lists.description: Any list longer than ~20 items must use FlashList, not FlatList or ScrollView
flashlist_large_lists.convention: estimatedItemSize must be provided. keyExtractor is required.

reanimated_worklet_animations.name: Reanimated Worklet-Driven Animations
reanimated_worklet_animations.description: All animations on the UI thread via Reanimated worklets. No JS-thread animations.
